The AI Roadmap

Where AI earns its keep — and where you stay in control.

AI is how I move fast without cutting corners. But the story, the taste, and the accountability are always human. Here's exactly where the two meet.

The division of labor

Every step knows who's driving.

Story & strategy

The human lead

Positioning, voice, and the point of view are decided by a person — not generated. AI drafts; you steer.

Design system

Co-pilot

Tokens, type, and color are reasoned out together. AI surfaces options and edge cases; the final call is yours.

Build & motion

Engine room

Components, layout, and interaction are built fast with AI in the loop — then reviewed line by line.

Review & ship

The human lead

Accessibility, performance, and copy get a real human pass before anything goes live. No autopilot ships.

AI accelerates. You decide.

The split behind every build

The honest version

Three things I won't let the hype get away from me.

◆

AI accelerates, it doesn't decide

Speed comes from tooling. Taste, judgment, and accountability still come from a person. That split is the whole point.

◆

Nothing ships on autopilot

Every line of copy, every interaction, every pixel gets a human review. AI drafts; a person signs off.

◆

You're never locked in

The site is yours — clean, portable code with no platform dependency. The tools change; your asset stays.
